US Troops Withdraw from Iraq After 12-Year Mission Against ISIS

The United States has completed the withdrawal of its troops from Iraq, concluding a 12-year mission focused on combating the Islamic State (ISIS). The operation, known as Operation Inherent Resolve, has officially ended. This withdrawal comes amid mounting regional security fears.
